name: bba-localllm-bridge
description: Expose Ollama and LM Studio models in the VS Code chat model picker.

scripts.check: npm run compile && npm run lint

commands.title: BBA LocalLLM Bridge: Inspect Tool Support
BBA LocalLLM Bridge: Configure Chat Visibility

bbaLocalLlmBridge.defaultProvider.description: Provider offered first in the management flow.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for provider discovery and chat requests.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.chatModelVisibility.markdownDescription: Controls how aggressively models are advertised as chat-capable in the VS Code Chat picker. `balanced` prefers showing likely chat models while retrying without tools if needed, `strict` only advertises tool calling when provider metadata or explicit allowlists say so, and `all-chat-models` advertises every non-embedding model for chat.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.ollama.enabled.description: Enable Ollama as a model source.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the Ollama server.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.ollama.models.description: Optional allowlist of Ollama model names. Leave empty to discover all models.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.ollama.toolCallingMode.description: Optional allowlist of Ollama models that should advertise tool-calling support. Leave empty to use name-based heuristics.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.lmStudio.enabled.description: Enable LM Studio as a model source.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.lmStudio.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the LM Studio local server.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.lmStudio.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional API key for LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible server. Many local setups accept any non-empty value.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.lmStudio.models.description: Optional allowlist of LM Studio model IDs. Leave empty to discover all models.

bbaLocalLlmBridge.lmStudio.toolCallingMo.description: Optional allowlist of LM Studio models that should advertise tool-calling support. Leave empty to use model metadata when available, otherwise fall back to name-based heuristics.
